INSERT INTO customs_declarations (citizen_id, declaration_id, date, country_from, goods_declared, status)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
           ON CONFLICT (citizen_id, declaration_id) DO UPDATE SET
              date = EXCLUDED.date,
              country_from = EXCLUDED.country_from,
              goods_declared = EXCLUDED.goods_declared,
              status = EXCLUDED.status
           RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
